Scopely is looking for a Community Manager to build strong relationships with Star Trek™ Fleet Command players and keep them informed, heard, and engaged.  You will work on a hybrid basis in our Barcelona hub.

You will work with internal teams to gather accurate information, turn it into useful player communications, and bring player feedback back to the people who can act on it.

You will help players understand what is happening in the game, give them meaningful ways to participate, and make sure their perspectives are represented across the team.

  • Write and publish player communications, including blogs, in-game news, patch notes, feature updates, event announcements, social posts, and livestream materials.
  • Coordinate with Product, Live Operations, Player Experience, and Marketing to gather information, confirm details, and deliver accurate communications on time.
  • Plan community engagement around game updates, events, and franchis

gr-318978.title_original: マーケティングプランナー
gr-318978.raw:
[담당 업무]
『ラストクラウディア』のマーケティング担当として、デジタル広告・SNS・生放送など、認知からエンゲージメントまで幅広いコミュニケーション手段を自ら企画・実行していただきます。

さらに当社では、自社で培ったノウハウを外部企業へ提供する「マーケティング事業」をトライアル展開中。ゆくゆくは外部企業の案件にも携わり、より多角的なプロモーション手腕を磨くことが可能です。

【具体的な業務内容】
入社後はまず、これまでのご経験を活かせる領域からスタートし、段階的に幅を広げていただきます。

・デジタルマーケティング: 広告運用（Google/Meta/X/TikTokなど）、効果測定・レポーティング、ASO施策
・クリエイティブディレクション: 広告動画・バナー等の仕様書作成、クオリティチェック
・ファンエンゲージメント: 生放送（公式番組）の台本制作・進行管理、SNSキャンペーンの立案、ノベルティ企画

募集背景

【自社タイトルの強化＆マーケティング事業のトライアル展開に伴う増員】
世界700万DL突破の『ラストクラウディア』。国内外で成功を収めてきた当社のプロモーションノウハウを活かし、このたび外部企業を支援する「マーケティング事業」トライアル展開することとなりました。
自社プロダクトをじっくり育てる面白さと、多様な外部案件に触れて打席数を増やす面白さ。その両方を手に入れ、市場価値を圧倒的に高められる環境を整えて、あなたをお待ちしています。

配属部署

マーケティング部
4名（企画職2名、デザイン職2名）

概要

「部分最適なマーケティングに物足りなさを感じていませんか？」
当社のマーケティングチームには、縦割りの壁がありません。デジタル広告の運用から、SNS、生放送の企画、さらには外部の事業会社を支援する「マーケティング事業」まで、あなたの意欲次第でどこまでも裁量の幅を広げられる環境です。

世界700万DLを突破した『ラストクラウディア』の次なる仕掛け人として、そして一人のビジネスパーソンとして、次のステップへ挑戦したいマーケターを募集します。

riot-8354416.title: Community Manager Intern - Summer 2027
riot-8354416.raw:
At Riot Games, Community Managers are responsible for providing game teams with strategic, upstream visibility into player needs and creative opportunities to exceed player expectations. For our Community, they are charged with ensuring players understand the current and future state of games. We strive to consistently and proactively manage player expectations and ensure we surprise and delight players at every opportunity.

As a Community Management Intern, you’ll work with Riot Games’ community teams to help execute programs and initiatives that deepen community engagement, build strong influencer relationships, and deliver impactful marketing communications that inspire, delight, and inform players across all of Riot’s games. You’ll help ensure our communications are both globally aligned and locally relevant to players across social media and partner with creators and influencers to bring campaigns to life. Overall, you will be part of the core team that connects our players, our brand, and our product teams to grow an engaged player community deeply connected to all of Riot’s IP. 

Responsibilities:

  • Work across Brand, Creative, Editorial, Influencer, Social and PR teams to champion player-first ideas and help build campaigns and strategies that support goals at the global level
  • Assist with the creation and execution of the communication strategy for players, including through social platforms and with our community of content creators
  • Work with the global Publishing team to escalate player needs and provide visibility into specific behaviors and trends
  • Help deliver player-facing opportunities and experiences that connect the community with key beats and events.
  • Coordinate with global and regional partners to ensure consistent messaging and impactful campaign delivery.
  • Track, analyze, and report on community, influencer, and social campaign impact to optimize future efforts.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a college, university or non-degree program
  • Graduating in the 2027 or 2028 calendar year
  • Available to work full-time hours for the 12 week internship duration
  • Experience or education in community management, influencer relations, marketing communications or related field
  • Familiarity with League of Legends, VALORANT, or Riot’s IP

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience

Our portfolio features iconic, critically acclaimed franchises across multiple platforms and genres, including NBA 2K, WWE 2K, PGA TOUR 2K, BioShock, Borderlands, Sid Meier’s Civilization, and XCOM.

Our central UR team has an incredible pipeline of high-impact, innovative work on the horizon across our flagship sports titles. We need a Senior Individual Contributor who lives and breathes sports media, interactive entertainment, sports gaming, and sports culture - someone who can translate fandom, gaming enthusiasm, and athletic mechanics into world-class player experiences.

We are looking for a top-tier user research practitioner who brings proactive communication, immaculate organizational discipline, and a consultative mindset.
